Bear Mountain Lodging has been bringing our dreams to life for over 14 years now. Our journey started when my husband and I made the bold decision to not only design and build our own cabins, but also manage and market them ourselves. Little did we know that taking this leap of faith would lead to the remarkable feeling of success we enjoy today.

Our original brand was focused on luxurious honeymoon cabins that would surpass our guests’ wildest expectations. The response we received was overwhelming, with past guests raving about their unforgettable experiences staying with us and wanting to return to the area with their families. We decided to give that market a shot as well because we understand the importance of quality family time. It has now become our mission to make every stay a treasured experience for everyone, from newlyweds to families of all sizes.

Through our continued growth over the years, we realized that we had turned too many guests away because of simply having nowhere to put them! In hopes of keeping up with that demand, we decided to take on a few more honeymoon and family cabins during which time we brought on our oldest daughter, Toni, to take on the role of our office manager.

We are currently in search of a few honeymoon and/or family cabins to add to our fleet. With our guests always being our top priority, we will continue to be a small business focused on customer service and maintaining the standards that have been set. As we continue to grow, I’m proud to introduce that our oldest daughter, Toni, will now be managing the cabins for owners that aren’t personally ours through Bear Mountain Management. Her passion for hospitality and genuine care for our guests ensure that every interaction is met with warmth and professionalism. Whether guests have questions, need assistance, or simply want to share their excitement about your upcoming stay, she is personally there to make sure the guests experience is nothing short of exceptional through email, text or phone. 

My daughter and I take great pride in the job that our cleaning/ maintenance service, A&M Cabin Care, provides. Through shared goals of creating the most memorable experiences for our guests, they provide meticulous attention to detail which guarantees that each cabin is impeccably clean and ready to welcome our valued guests.

In today’s digital age, we understand the importance of maintaining an online presence. That’s why we have actively engaged with platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, showcasing the unique features of our cabins and sharing exciting updates with our followers. We believe that connecting with our guests and potential guests through these channels allows us to offer a more personalized experience and build meaningful relationships. We also provide direct booking for our guests through our website. 

If you have a romantic or family “one of a kind” cabin, and are looking for a well-established management company who treats each cabin like their own, please contact my daughter, Toni, for more information. She would love the opportunity to visit with you and answer any questions you may have about her services.
